- name: Set isolated Cargo paths after runner allocation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s/cargo-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/target-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR=%s/ci-observations\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Install pinned native release compiler
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal
      - name: Install matching native formatter
        run: rustup component add --toolchain 1.95.0 rustfmt
      - name: Execute native release setup and repeated-search costs
        run: python3 scripts/ci/run_cross_arch_cost.py --arch "${{ matrix.arch }}"
      - name: Execute native zero-matrix locality costs
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/run_cross_arch_cost.py --arch "${{ matrix.arch }}" --suite zero-locality --zero-version 2
      - name: Execute native one-zero rank-one locality costs
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/run_cross_arch_cost.py --arch "${{ matrix.arch }}" --suite one-zero-locality
      - name: Execute native fixed maintenance producer and preparation costs
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/run_cross_arch_cost.py --arch "${{ matrix.arch }}" --suite maintenance-paired
      - name: Execute native legal and late-rejection verifier costs
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/pon_work_rejection_report.py --run --out "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/work-rejection"
      - name: Execute exact native from-zero service controls
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/run_from_zero_native.py --out "$TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR/from-zero-native"
      - name: Verify source remained unchanged
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA"
      - name: Retain native cost successes and failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
